description:
Sol QA, regression from T-040. shell_parse.executable_text("cat '<<EOF'\ngit commit --no-verify\nEOF") returns only "cat '<<EOF'", so command_findings returns [] and the real git commit --no-verify passes. The heredoc detection matches << inside a quoted word.

Fix: only strip a body when the << operator is unquoted in the tokenized command line. Acceptance: that command gives commit_gate_bypass; the T-040 literal-body cases still pass. Tests by adw-test-writer.
title: Treat a quoted <<EOF as an argument, not a heredoc
